title: THREE THINGS THAT RUN
rule: client work first, then three things that run, all three the owner's own projects built from their real code (OFFBEAT drum row, FORM trefoil, Morse Trainer key); everything else is text and real screens; two explaining figures play once in view and end complete
description: A dark page. First screen: 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps.', 'Rebuilds a live care platform, one tested screen at a time.', '5+ years · part of two platform rewrites · Kosovo, works remotely', then a small line 'Further down, three own projects run on the page: a drum machine, a sculpture and a Morse key.', and the real care team calendar as a still. Under it two explaining figures that play once in view and end complete: 'How a change gets into the new app' (the AI line; old app, test first, agents build, checks, person approves; the dot walks, a check fails, it goes back to the agents, then passes) with one 'Play again' button, and 'One billing report' (16 marks become 2). Then six client screens (Bayyinah library, the Design System date range picker, Viva Fresh, Read to Feed, Dukagjini, the Incentiv sign-in card with 'Gentrit built the sign-in and dashboard screens…'), then the three live objects, then Offday, FJALË and Za!, then contact.
signature: Gentrit Display (Hubot Sans) at width 100 for the name line (56 px) and section names (26 px, sentence case); width 120 only inside the objects; Public Sans 17/14 for everything else. Ground #141311, bone #F2EDE4, muted #A7A29A; OFFBEAT's hot #FF5A36 and acid #D9F26B stay inside the drum row and the Morse key only; links, focus ring and the explaining figures use bone. The FORM band takes the metal colour.
hook: You tap a few steps on the OFFBEAT drum row and it plays; then you key a K on his Morse trainer and the page tells you it is right.
holdback: Lowest: seniority, original and type, 7/10. The client work is still a two-column tile grid, a familiar pattern, and 'live objects on a dark page' is the family of round 10's live-objects draft. The phone page is long (8,642 px at 390). The trefoil holds 60 fps only with a real GPU.
